name: agent_wakes_on_a_row
title: Agents · an agent wakes when a row is added, once, and never on its own writes

steps.say: make a table named deals with each deal's name, its EBITDA in millions and its stage
steps.reply:
I made a **Deals** table in a new module called **Deal pipeline**. The app wouldn't let the module and the table share the name "Deals", so I gave the module that name. The table is empty and has three columns:

- **Name**: what each deal is called.
- **EBITDA**: in millions. I assumed US dollars, so it shows as $M.
- **Stage**: a dropdown with Sourcing, Screening, Due diligence, LOI, Closing, Closed and Passed. You didn't list your stages, so I used a common deal pipeline as a starting point.

steps.say: add a deal: Midwest HVAC, EBITDA 2.1, stage new
steps.reply:
I added **Midwest HVAC** to your Deals table with an EBITDA of $2.1M.

"New" isn't one of the stage options, so I put it in **Sourcing**, the earliest stage. If you want "New" as a stage of its own, I can add it.
